description: The restored view exposes original text, values, tags, and token endpoints (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text (Q $x:candidate Y) %conditions $x.without-elision.source-text = "x", $x.without-elision.value = "x", $x.without-elision.tags = X, ¬($x.without-elision.starts-input), $x.without-elision.first-token.source-text = "x", $x.without-elision.last-token.source-text = "x", $x.without-elision.tokens-after-first.source-text = "", $x.without-elision.following-tokens.matches(following)

%rule candidate (X [+T]) :: Private
%rule following Y
